why: UNIVERSES: A is the conjunction of the 22 listed theorems at universe 0 (SuppInSat, bsec, tsec are vocabulary); B is on SEP.{0}. B ⇒ A is not proved: A's conjuncts are about an arbitrary TransportInput over an arbitrary ZSetup (any β with SuppInSat, any ŝ satisfying the conclusion of Proposition 14.4.14), while B covers only the §14.3 data with Lemma 14.5.1 cut-offs under the standing hypotheses; the remaining conjuncts are facts about the project's construction (IndexCorr, sectionSmul, bsec, tsec), not consequences of B.
